notice: Planning score combines conservatively matched published records with simulated fallback values. Published records are not field-verified; resource effects and eligibility remain simulated.

communityPoints.dateCaveat: generatedAt is the conversion timestamp, not the date each location was surveyed.

method.score: Sum of dimension weight multiplied by level (0, 0.5 or 1). Conservatively matched published records set some intermediate states; unmatched dimensions use simulated levels. Historical cyclone proximity is not an input.
method.assumptionAssignment: Stable SHA-256 assignment from modelVersion, communityId and dimension; not inferred from a community's actual conditions. A route/power consistency constraint is then applied.
method.resourceEffect: Eligible resources advance one state in exactly one target dimension; scoreAfter is recalculated using the same weights.
method.missingActualData: Unknown real-world capability is not zero. Published matches support only cautious intermediate states; current operation, tests and community reach are not inferred. Unmatched dimensions use a stable simulated fallback.
method.costUnits: Relative simulation units, not dollars or procurement estimates.

route_redundancy.label: Independent communications route
route_redundancy.simulationReason: No public-access satellite backup site could be matched within 1 km of this community point. Provider/backhaul or more distant facility records alone do not establish a usable community backup route.

sourcesReviewed.name: NT Remote Communities with Mobile Coverage and Backhaul Transmission
sourcesReviewed.limitation: Community-level location/provider/backhaul context; not proof of an independent backup route or failover test.

sourcesReviewed.name: ACCC Mobile Infrastructure Report data release
sourcesReviewed.limitation: Mobile sites/operators do not reveal independent backhaul/failure domains; shared MOCN records must not be double-counted.

sourcesReviewed.name: STAND Sky Muster deployments
sourcesReviewed.limitation: A mapped deployment is not verified community-level route independence or availability during an emergency.

backup_power.label: Backup power
backup_power.simulationReason: No completed MNHP power upgrade was matched to this named community. Nearby or regional project records do not establish this community's backup-power capability.

sourcesReviewed.name: Mobile Network Hardening Program (MNHP)
sourcesReviewed.limitation: Funded upgrade/site records; stage 1 describes a 12-hour target, not present-day operation or a passed community-level test.

sourcesReviewed.name: NT Remote Small Cells program update
sourcesReviewed.limitation: Program-level report of new coverage; not a per-community runtime, maintenance or test register.

critical_service_continuity.label: Critical-service communications continuity
critical_service_continuity.simulationReason: Territory/local emergency plans describe coordination and arrangements, but available records do not verify a critical facility's communications plan and successful test.

sourcesReviewed.name: NT Territory Emergency Plan
sourcesReviewed.limitation: Territory-level emergency coordination; not facility-specific continuity/test evidence.

sourcesReviewed.name: NT Emergency Service local emergency plans
sourcesReviewed.limitation: Local arrangements do not consistently establish critical-service plan implementation or successful drills.

alerts_and_offline.label: Alerts and offline information
alerts_and_offline.simulationReason: Public plans and mapped facilities identify potential channels, but do not verify reach, offline availability or test results for this community.

sourcesReviewed.name: NT Emergency Service local emergency plans
sourcesReviewed.limitation: A listed channel is not proof of reception by residents or successful offline testing.

sourcesReviewed.name: STAND Sky Muster deployments
sourcesReviewed.limitation: Map is illustrative; the publisher warns a site may not be used during an emergency.

sourcesReviewed.name: Secure NT Emergency Alert guidance
sourcesReviewed.limitation: Explains alert-system limits; mobile alerts are not offline when phone service is unavailable.

operational_readiness.label: Operations and maintenance readiness
operational_readiness.simulationReason: Published plans name agencies and coordination roles, but no community-level device owner, maintenance log and completed drill evidence is linked to this point.

sourcesReviewed.name: NT Territory Emergency Plan
sourcesReviewed.limitation: Defines government coordination responsibilities; not a local maintenance or completed exercise record.

sourcesReviewed.name: NT Emergency Service local emergency plans
sourcesReviewed.limitation: Emergency arrangements are not proof that telecommunications maintenance or drills occurred.

resourceCatalog.caveat: Independent power, service plan, installation and local suitability still require verification.
resourceCatalog.effect: Advance target dimension by one simulated state, capped at level 1
